items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Terminology 6:1
items.html: The NHY of ZA are completed only through the illumination of Hochma, and they are considered his backs, where the shells cling, so long as they contain no illumination of Hochma. (p. 503, Item 26)
